matrix.description: 默认环境，不加载额外插件，用于观察原生 DSH 能力。

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=pwd; ls -a; git status 2>&1 | head -20; git remote -v

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=echo TMPDIR=$TMPDIR; ls -ld /tmp; touch <TEMP_PATH> && echo "tmp writable" && rm <TEMP_PATH>

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=set -e ISO=$TMPDIR/iso-capability-environment-cloud rm -rf "$ISO"; mkdir -p "$ISO" cp -r <TEMP_PATH> "$ISO"/ cd "$ISO"

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd "$TMPDIR/iso-capability-environment-cloud" && git add README.md && git commit -qm "docs: record sandbox capability probe" && git log --oneline && git diff HEAD~1 -- README.md
